# Upstream Source

This package and its sibling `explore_lite_msgs` are imported from
[`robo-friends/m-explore-ros2`](https://github.com/robo-friends/m-explore-ros2)
at commit `326cf8a0b487c34246bb8f3326afbcd69576dc60`.

Only the single-robot frontier exploration packages are included. The upstream
multi-robot map merging package is intentionally excluded because this robot
uses one `slam_toolbox` map.

The imported code is distributed under the BSD license in `LICENSE`.
